breaking_news.headline: Nvidia forecast reignites AI trade and lifts Nasdaq 1.57%
breaking_news.summary: Nvidia surged after Q2 results and a long-range forecast indicating roughly 70% revenue growth in the fiscal year ending January 2028. S&P 500 gained 0.72%, Nasdaq 1.57%, Dow 0.20%.
breaking_news.market_impact: AI leadership returned, but breadth was mixed and most S&P sectors lagged technology.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Positive read-through for TSMC, advanced packaging, AI servers, networking, PCB, cooling and power.

breaking_news.headline: U.S. considers another broad round of semiconductor tariffs
breaking_news.summary: The Trump administration is considering sweeping new tariffs on semiconductors, according to Politico as cited by Reuters.
breaking_news.market_impact: Adds trade-policy risk to chip hardware and data-center supply chains despite strong AI demand.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Raises policy and customer-mix risk for Taiwan semiconductor and server exporters; watch exemptions and implementation details.

breaking_news.headline: WTI rebounds to $83.53 as U.S.-Iran diplomacy stalls
breaking_news.summary: WTI rose about 1.6% after reports the U.S. was not interested in returning to prior Iran memorandum terms.
breaking_news.market_impact: Geopolitical premium returned to oil, partially offsetting the risk-on impulse from AI earnings.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Higher oil is a cost headwind for transport and manufacturers; the technology complex remains driven mainly by AI demand and rates.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Post-earnings rally confirms AI demand remains strong
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Nvidia Q2 revenue was $96.22B and adjusted EPS $2.22; Q3 revenue guide is $108B +/-2%. The company also indicated around 70% growth for the fiscal year ending January 2028.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Reduces near-term fear of an AI capex slowdown and lifted semiconductors and software.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Strong positive read-through for TSMC foundry, CoWoS, server ODM, networking, PCB, cooling and power.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: AI strength meets new U.S. semiconductor tariff risk
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: The U.S. is considering a new broad tariff round on semiconductors while Nvidia's results reinforce accelerator demand.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Fundamentals are strong, but policy risk can change relative winners across foundry, packaging, custom silicon and systems.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Favor diversified exposure and monitor tariff scope rather than assuming all semiconductor names benefit equally.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Megacap AI/software sentiment improves with Salesforce and CrowdStrike beats
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Salesforce and CrowdStrike rallied sharply after stronger results and raised outlooks, easing fears that AI would only benefit chip vendors.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Broader software participation improves market breadth around AI.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Supports enterprise AI infrastructure demand, indirectly positive for servers, networking and data-center hardware.

narration_points: 美股8月27日由科技股領漲，標普上漲0.72%、那斯達克大漲1.57%，NVIDIA財報後漲幅接近一成，AI主線重新成為市場核心。
NVIDIA不只本季優於預期，還預估截至2028年1月的財年營收成長約70%，強化台積電、CoWoS、AI伺服器、網通、PCB、散熱與電源的中期需求能見度。
市場並非全面風險偏好：10年期殖利率約4.67%，WTI反彈至83.53美元，美國又傳出考慮新一輪半導體關稅，估值與政策仍是AI供應鏈的主要風險。
台幣8月27日官方收31.708；台指期日盤收46078點，未平倉104881口，外資期貨淨未平倉約負84836口。
盤前仍以美股RRG與台股Rotation雙重確認，不因NVIDIA單日大漲就把所有AI族群視為同等強勢。
